parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem:
Radioactive decay is both random and spontaneous.

State what is meant by:

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
A sample of radioactive material contains atoms of an unstable nuclide $X$. The activity of the sample due to the atoms of $X$ is $A$. The variation with time $t$ of $\ln A$ is shown in Fig. 12.1.

{{figure:figure_12_1}}
parts.text: Use Fig. 12.1 to determine the half-life, in minutes, of nuclide $X$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
At time $t = 0$, the mass of the atoms of $X$ in the sample is $5.66 \times 10^{-7} \text{kg}$.

Determine the nucleon number of $X$.
